from solution import find_Sum


def test_issue_example():
    """Issue example: sum of repeated elements in [1,2,3,1,1,4,5,6] is 3."""
    assert find_Sum([1, 2, 3, 1, 1, 4, 5, 6], 8) == 3  # 1+1+1=3


def test_issue_no_repeats_zero():
    """Issue rule: sum of repeated elements is 0 when nothing repeats."""
    assert find_Sum([1, 2, 3, 4], 4) == 0  # no repeats=0


def test_issue_single_pair_sums_both():
    """Issue rule: sum of repeated elements counts both copies of a pair."""
    assert find_Sum([5, 5], 2) == 10  # 5+5=10


def test_issue_triple_sums_all_three():
    """Issue rule: sum of repeated elements counts all three copies."""
    assert find_Sum([4, 4, 4, 5], 4) == 12  # 4+4+4=12


def test_issue_two_values_repeated():
    """Issue rule: sum of repeated elements includes every repeated value."""
    assert find_Sum([1, 1, 2, 2, 3], 5) == 6  # 1+1+2+2=6


def test_issue_all_same():
    """Issue rule: sum of repeated elements in all-same array is full sum."""
    assert find_Sum([2, 2, 2, 2], 4) == 8  # 2+2+2+2=8


def test_issue_empty_array():
    """Issue rule: sum of repeated elements in empty array is 0."""
    assert find_Sum([], 0) == 0  # empty sum=0


def test_issue_singleton():
    """Issue rule: sum of repeated elements with one element is 0."""
    assert find_Sum([7], 1) == 0  # single no-repeat=0


def test_issue_negative_repeat():
    """Issue rule: sum of repeated elements works for negative numbers."""
    assert find_Sum([-1, -1, 2, 3], 4) == -2  # -1+-1=-2


def test_issue_zero_repeated():
    """Issue rule: sum of repeated elements counts repeated zeros."""
    assert find_Sum([0, 0, 1], 3) == 0  # 0+0=0


def test_contract_result_is_int():
    """Contract: find_Sum(arr, n) returns an int sum."""
    result = find_Sum([1, 1, 2], 3)  # 1+1=2
    assert result == 2  # 1+1=2
    assert isinstance(result, int)


def test_contract_input_unchanged():
    """Contract: find_Sum(arr, n) must not mutate the input array."""
    arr = [3, 3, 4]
    assert find_Sum(arr, 3) == 6  # 3+3=6
    assert arr == [3, 3, 4]  # unchanged list
